verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own receipt upload with automatic matching to existing expenses (Receipt Match in the Expenses API). That covers the 'files it against the right transaction' core of the story. The capture channels and OCR step are not evidenced: no photo-snap flow in the mobile app, no email-forwarding inbox, and no explicit receipt OCR or data extraction. Missing for 10: documented mobile photo capture of receipts, an email-forward receipt intake address, explicit OCR/field extraction from receipts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of match accuracy.

support.subject: As an employee, I can snap a photo or forward an email and the platform OCRs the receipt and files it against the right transaction

citations.quote: The uri will be a pre-signed S3 URL allowing you to upload the receipt securely... we will try to match the receipt with existing expenses.
Receipt Match: Upload receipt and match automatically.
AI assistants do employees' expenses for them, writing memos, fetching receipts, offering policy help, even filing reimbursements automatically.
